name: HostelVerse
description: A full-stack hostel management platform built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Node.js, Express.js and MySQL.

paragraphs: HostelVerse is a full-stack web application developed to simplify everyday hostel life by providing a single platform for essential hostel activities. HostelVerse aims to create a centralized, user-friendly, and scalable platform that improves communication and everyday convenience for hostel students. By combining multiple hostel services into one application, it eliminates the need for scattered communication channels while providing a seamless and modern digital hostel experience.
features: Create an anonymous roommate profile using personal preferences and a unique pet name. Students can browse compatible profiles, send connection requests, and reveal contact information only after mutual acceptance.
A hostel-exclusive marketplace where students can buy and sell items. Users can upload product images, add descriptions, contact sellers, and mark products as sold once the transaction is completed.
Students can report hostel-related issues through a centralized complaint board. Complaints remain visible to everyone, making it easier to track ongoing hostel concerns.
Create and browse hostel events by providing the event title, date, time, venue, and description. This keeps students informed about upcoming hostel activities and gatherings.
Report found items by uploading an image along with the location, date, and description. Students can browse and search reported items to quickly recover their belongings.
